description: Presidential Secretariat - Call out with effect from 22.01.2023 all the members of the Armed forces for the maintenance of Public Order
reasoning: This gazette content is an order made under the Public Security Ordinance, which is a legal/regulatory instrument. It exercises powers vested by statute (Chapter 40) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order, representing a regulatory action under existing legal authority rather than a government personnel change or administrative restructuring.
